channel.title: Revive
channel.description: Updates for Revive, the free and open source Mac cleaner.

item.title: Revive 0.4.2
item.description:
What's new

  • Checkup Run does it all: maintenance tasks, confirmed malware removal, Homebrew app updates and cleanup, each with its own checkbox, then a summary of what worked and what didn't.
  • Storage Map: hovering now follows the pointer bubble by bubble; the hovered bubble grows and its neighbors move aside.
  • Clear errors everywhere: Security, Apps, Declutter, Cloud Storage and login items show what could not be removed, and keep those items in the list.
  • Move to Applications: opened from the disk image, Revive offers to move itself to Applications, so macOS asks for approval only once.
  • Full Disk Access stays on: development builds no longer reset the installed app's permission.

item.title: Revive 0.4.1
item.description:
What's new

  • Automatic updates: Revive checks for a new version at launch and every hour, and installs it in one click when you agree (Settings › Updates, or Revive › Check for Updates…).
  • Permissions kept across updates: releases are now signed with a stable certificate, so macOS keeps Full Disk Access from one version to the next.
  • French translations for the new settings.

Installing

Coming from 0.4.0? Download this version once by hand; later versions arrive automatically.

On first launch, macOS asks to confirm: System Settings › Privacy & Security › Open Anyway.
